一旦……就……: Once the first situation happens, the second follows; it presents a decisive condition.
如果……就……: If the condition is met, the consequence follows; 就 is sometimes omitted.
即使……也……: Even if the condition holds, the result remains true.
虽然……可是……: Concession: although A is true, B contrasts with it.
无论……都……: Regardless of the condition or choice, the outcome does not change.
不管……都……: No matter what happens, the following result still applies.
连……都……: Even an extreme or unexpected case meets the result; used to emphasize scope.
被……: Passive voice: highlights what happens to the affected person or object.
将……: Written-style disposal marker, like 把, placing the affected object before the action.
把……: Disposal construction: highlights what someone does to a specific object.
……不由……: Involuntary reaction: cannot help responding in the described way.
只见……: Narrative viewpoint: ‘one saw’ or ‘there appeared’; introduces a newly observed scene.
……竟然……: Surprising result contrary to expectation: unexpectedly or actually.
……顿时……: A result happens suddenly or immediately, often during an action scene.
……仿佛……: Literary simile: as if, as though; the following image is a comparison.
……如同……: Literary comparison: like or as; equates two scenes or appearances figuratively.
……犹如……: Literary comparison: just like; heightens an image in narrative description.
……这才……: Only then: a change or realization occurs after a preceding event.
……原本……: Originally or at first, often contrasted with how the situation changed.
……甚至……: Escalates an example to an even more surprising or extreme case.
……乃至于……: Extends the preceding range or degree: even to the point of.
……按照……: Following a stated method, instruction, sequence, or standard.
……之所以……: Introduces the reason why a situation came about; often paired with 是因为.
……似乎……: A cautious inference: it seems or appears that something is so.
……毕竟……: After all: supplies an important reason or qualification.
……难以……: Finds an action or experience difficult to accomplish.
等到……: When a later event finally takes place, the following action can occur.
……既然……: Since a fact is established, the following conclusion or action is justified.
……只有……才……: Only when the stated condition is satisfied can the result happen.
……除非……: Unless or only if: specifies an exception to a preceding rule.
……唯有……: Only or nothing but; a literary way to name the sole possibility.
……越来越……: A quality or intensity increases progressively over time.
……而是……: Corrective contrast: rather than the previously mentioned alternative.
……才……: The action happens only then, or only after a certain condition is fulfilled.
……再也……: From then on, something no longer happens or cannot happen again (often with 不/没).
……终于……: After delay or difficulty, an event finally takes place.
……然而……: Written contrast: however, the following fact changes the expected course.
……甚至于……: An intensified extension of a preceding statement: even up to.
……若是……: Literary or narrative-style if; introduces a hypothetical condition.
